tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every BlatUI component with its title and one-line description. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search BlatUI components, blocks and charts by name, title or description.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get a component's full Blade source, dependencies, required packages and install command.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Get the full Blade source of a block or chart, plus the components and packages it needs.

tools.name: install_command
tools.description: Build the exact `php artisan blatui:add` command plus required composer/npm packages for one or more components.
